opening.argument: The title pairs GMX and Arbitrum with a “+15% per annum” return, while the narration reports weekly commission income of $2.5 and says that income is paid in ETH tokens. It makes receiving that commission conditional on purchasing the JLP crypto index, presenting a cryptocurrency income opportunity alongside GMX balances and earned ETH. Yet the material does not establish the return as guaranteed, and it does not verify the required purchase amount or the figures presented. The promotion therefore rests on unverified appreciation or income claims tied to a token purchase.

citations.quote: DEX Exchange GMX ARBITRUM +15% per annum
In a week, the income on the commissions was $ 2.5.
To receive the commission, you need to purchase the JLP crypto index
Income is paid in ETH tokens.
